title: The bear named after a sloth

scenes.headline: This bear was named after the wrong animal

subtitle: it's a true bear
claws dig out termites
the tooth gap sucks them up
but the name stuck

caption:
Wrong family, right name forever.

Sloth bears are also the only bears that routinely carry their cubs on their back, until the cubs are about 6 to 9 months old.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo; Animal Diversity Web.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Naming-history storytime told entirely in subtitle chunks over four wild sloth bear photos (Ranthambore, Wilpattu, Bor); ends on a mother with cubs to set up the caption fact.
